How to Submit Public Comment

Members of the Public who wish to submit public comment may do so using one of
the following methods. Public comment is limited to the time allotted.

In-Person: Complete a Speaker Card, indicating the agenda item number and submit
it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. Speakers shall be limited to three (3) minutes
per person per item. At the Mayor’s discretion, the time limit may be shortened to allow
all speakers to address the City Council. Please note that interactions between the City
Council, City staff, and the public during meetings are subject to the City’s Rules of
Decorum.

Website: Electronic submission of Public Comment is available via the online public
comment form at Public Comment. Public Comment submitted electronically by 4:00
P.M. on the meeting day will be forwarded to the City Council before the meeting for
their consideration, but will not be read during the meeting. Comments submitted after
4:00 P.M. will be forwarded to Council but may not be received before the meeting.

  D. AWARD CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT NO. 25-09 TO SOUTHWEST
  PIPELINE AND TRENCHLESS CORPORATION FOR THE SAN GABRIEL
  BOULEVARD SEWER REHABILITATION PROJECT IN THE AMOUNT OF
  $779,305 PLUS A 10% CONTINGENCY

  The proposed project will rehabilitate the existing sewer line on San Gabriel
  Boulevard from Angeleno Avenue to Marshall Street utilizing trenchless cured-
  in-place-pipe sewer lining technology. Southwest Pipeline & Trenchless
  Corporation submitted the lowest responsive bid for the San Gabriel Boulevard
  Sewer Rehabilitation Project, totaling $779,305, plus a 10% contingency.

  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Determination: This project is
  determined to be Categorical Exempt per CEQA Section 15301 – the project
  consists of minor alterations to existing public right of way facilities. No
  significant environmental impacts are anticipated for this project.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council:

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – November 4, 2025  3
   1. Approve plans and specifications for the San Gabriel Boulevard Sewer
  Rehabilitation Project (CIP 4-12-05);
  2. Award the contract to Southwest Pipeline & Trenchless Corporation;
  3. Authorize the City Manager to execute Construction Contract No. 25-09;
  and
  4. Approve a purchase order in the amount of $857,235.50 which includes a
  10% construction contingency.

  E. THEATRE RENTAL FEE WAIVER REQUEST BY OLYMPIA PHILHARMONIC
  SOCIETY

  Olympia Philharmonic Society is planning a youth orchestra concert at the
  Mission Playhouse on January 11, 2026, and has requested a partial fee waiver:
  a reduction from $6,659.50 to $3,784.50. The event will be presented to the
  community at no charge for admission. The City has budgeted $12,000 in its
  annual Rental Subsidy account, account number 152-3532, for fiscal year 2025-
  2026 from which the waiver would be charged. Should the City Council approve
  staff’s recommendation, the remaining balance would be $9,850.

  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Determination: Not a Project as
  defined in Section 15378 of the State CEQA Guidelines.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council approve a partial fee waiver of the San
  Gabriel Mission Playhouse facility rental fee in the amount of $2,150 for the
  January 11, 2026 performance day.

  A. ORDINANCE NO. 724 AMENDING TITLE III: ADMINISTRATION, CHAPTER
  30 CITY COUNCIL, SECTION 30.02 COMPENSATION OF THE SAN GABRIEL
  MUNICIPAL CODE TO ADJUST THE COMPENSATION OF CITY COUNCIL
  MEMBERS PURSUANT TO SENATE BILL 329 – INTRODUCTION AND FIRST
  READING

  Senate Bill 329 changed the salary cap for city council members to help account
  for the 300% increase in the cost of living since the last update in 1984. In order
  to account for inflation and facilitate more diverse city councils, options for

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – November 4, 2025  4
   increasing Council Member compensation are presented for City Council
  consideration. San Gabriel City Council Member compensation was last
  adjusted in 2009 to $893.70 monthly, pursuant to Ordinance No. 573-C.S. City
  Council compensation is proposed to increase from $893.70 per month, per
  member, to either a maximum of $1,275 (Option 1) or $1,608.66 (Option 2A).
  Under Option 1, the impact to the General Fund would be an additional $381.30
  per month ($4,575.60 annually) per Council Member, or $22,878 total each year
  for all five members. Under Option 2A, the increase would be $714.96 per
  month ($8,579.52 annually) per Council Member, or $42,897.60 total annually
  for all five members. There would be no fiscal impact in the current fiscal year;
  funds for the increased compensation would be included in the Fiscal Year
  2026–27 Budget.

  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Determination: Not a Project as
  defined in Section 15378 of the State CEQA Guidelines.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council:

  1. Waive full reading, read by title only, and introduce for first reading
  Ordinance No. 724 entitled, “An Ordinance of the City Council of San Gabriel,
  California, Amending Title III: Administration, Chapter 30 City Council, Section
  30.02 Compensation of the San Gabriel Municipal Code to adjust the
  Compensation of City Council Members Pursuant to Senate Bill 329,”
  incorporating either Option 1 or 2(A) for the compensation amount.

  2. Waive future reading and schedule the second reading and adoption of
  Ordinance No. 724 for the next regularly-scheduled City Council meeting.

  ALTERNATIVES

  City Council may decide to:

  1. Not approve the ordinance at introduction; or

  2. Increase compensation to another amount under the maximum of $1,608.66

 8. CITY MANAGER’S REPORT

MINUTES OF NOVEMBER 4, 2025
  REGULAR MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Menchaca called the regular meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at
  6:31 P.M. on Tuesday, November 4, 2025, in the Council Chamber at City Hall, 425 South
  Mission Drive, San Gabriel, California, 91776.

  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Council Member Herrera Avila.

  ROLL CALL

  Council Members Present:  Tony Ding, Jorge Herrera Avila, John Wu, Vice Mayor
  Eric Chan, and Mayor Denise Menchaca.
  Council Members Absent:  None.
  Staff Members Present:  City Manager Mark Lazzaretto, City Attorney Keith
  Lemieux, Community Services Director Rebecca Perez,

I
  Chief City Clerk Sharon Clark, Fire Chief Steven Wallace,
  Police Chief Edward Elizalde, Acting Public Works
  Director/City Engineer Szeka Cheng, Community
  Development Director David Sanchez, and Assistant City
  Clerk Adam Yang.

  ANNOUNCEMENTS

  Chief City Clerk Clark provided information for the public on how to view the meeting.

  1. APPROVAL OF AGENDA ORDER

  Mayor Menchaca approved the agenda order.

  2. PRESENTATIONS

  A. NATIVE AMERICAN HERITAGE MONTH

  Mayor Menchaca made the presentation and Chief Anthony Morales of the

I  Gabrieleno San Gabriel Band of Mission Indians and Chairperson Andrew Salas of
  the Kizh/Gabrieleno Band of Mission Indians accepted the proclamation.

  B. LUNG CANCER AWARENESS MONTH

  Mayor Menchaca made the presentation.

  3. PUBLIC COMMENT - None

  CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 1 of 4  November 4, 2025
   4. CONSENT CALENDAR

  A motion was made by Council Member Ding, seconded by Vice Mayor Chan, to
  approve Consent Calendar Items 4A - 4E as presented.

  Motion carried by a vote of 5-0 as follows:

  AYES:  DING, HERRERA AVILA, WU, CHAN, MENCHACA
  NOES:  NONE
  ABSTAIN:  NONE

I  ABSENT:  NONE

  A. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  The City Council approved:

  1. Minutes of the Special City Council Meeting of October 21, 2025.
  2. Minutes of the Regular City Council Meeting of October 21, 2025.

  B. MATERIAL DEMANDS

  The City Council approved October 9 and 17, 2025, Material Demands for the
  payment of City expenditures.

  C. 2026 CITY COUNCIL MEETING SCHEDULE

  The City Council approved the 2026 City Council meeting schedule.

I  D. AWARD CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT NO. 25-09 TO SOUTHWEST PIPELINE
  AND TRENCHLESS CORPORATION FOR THE SAN GABRIEL BOULEVARD
  SEWER REHABILITATION PROJECT IN THE AMOUNT OF $779,305 PLUS A 10%
  CONTINGENCY

  The City Council:

  1. Approved plans and specifications for the San Gabriel Boulevard Sewer
  Rehabilitation Project (CIP 4-12-05);
  2. Awarded the contract to Southwest Pipeline & Trenchless Corporation;
  3. Authorized the City Manager to execute Construction Contract No. 25-09; and
  4. Approved a purchase order in the amount of $857,235.50 which includes a 10%
  construction contingency.

  E. THEATRE RENTAL FEE WAIVER REQUEST BY OLYMPIA PHILHARMONIC
  SOCIETY

  The City Council approved a partial fee waiver of the San Gabriel Mission Playhouse
  facility rental fee in the amount of $2,150 for the January 11, 2026 performance

I  day.

  5. PUBLIC HEARING - None.

  6. CONTINUED BUSINESS - None.

  7. NEW BUSINESS

  A. ORDINANCE NO. 724 AMENDING TITLE Ill: ADMINISTRATION, CHAPTER 30
  CITY COUNCIL, SECTION 30.02 COMPENSATIONL OF THE SAN GABRIEL
  CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 2 of 4  November 4, 2025
   MUNICIPAL CODE TO ADJUST THE COMPENSATION OF CITY COUNCIL
  MEMBERS PURSUANT TO SENATE BILL 329 - INTRODUCTION AND FIRST
  READING

  Chief City Clerk Clark made the staff presentation.

  There was no public comment.

  Discussion included the greater scope of responsibility for the San Gabriel City

I  Council in a full-service city as compared to some of the neighboring cities; the
  appropriateness of increasing compensation which hasn't changed since 2009;
  benefits of an increased salary to attract more interest and diversity in serving on
  Council; ancillary costs and time council members incur; and a proposal to reduce
  Council salaries to $0 to earn trust with the community.
  A motion was made by Mayor Menchaca, seconded by Vice Mayor Chan, to:

  1. Waive full reading, read by title only, and introduce for first reading Ordinance
  No. 724 entitled, "An Ordinance of the City Council of San Gabriel, California,
  Amending Title Ill: Administration, Chapter 30 City Council, Section 30.02
  Compensation of the San Gabriel Municipal Code to adjust the Compensation
  of City Council Members Pursuant to Senate Bill 329," incorporating a salary
  increase to $1,275 monthly.

  2. Waive future reading and schedule the second reading and adoption of
  Ordinance No. 724 for the next regularly-scheduled City Council meeting.

  Motion carried by a vote of 4- 7 as follows:

  AYES:  DING, HERRERA AVILA, CHAN, MENCHACA

I  NOES:
  ABSTAIN:
  ABSENT:
  WU
  NONE
  NONE

  8. CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

  City Manager Lazzaretto announced the City's Dia de los Muertos event to be held on
  November 7, 2025, at 5:30 P.M., with a free drone show at 8:30 P.M., and the Veterans
  Day celebration to be held on November 8, 2025, at 10:00 AM.; and announced that
  the first two proposed designs for the Veterans' Memorial had been received.

  9. COUNCIL COMMENTS AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS

  Mayor Menchaca announced the City's participation in Operation Green Light to
  honor veterans from November 4 - 11, 2025, and thanked veterans and their families
  for their service and sacrifice.

  Vice Mayor Chan reported on his attendance at the Tawa Gateway (formerly Focus

I  Plaza) grand opening, San Gabriel Fall Fun Festival in the Mission District, and an
  Arcadia Chamber of Commerce mixer; and invited all to the City's Dia de Los Muertos
  event to be held on November 7, 2025, at the Mission Playhouse.

  Council Member Herrera Avila reported on his attendance at the Tawa Gateway grand
  opening, Mariachi los Comperos, and City Employee Halloween lunch, and
  congratulated the Finance Department for winning the Department costume prize.

  Council Member Ding reported on his attendance at the Tawa Gateway grand
  opening; San Gabriel Fall Fun Festival; Chinese University Alumni Association Alliance

  CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 3 of 4  November 4, 2025
   of Southern California 23 rd SZM Outdoor Gala; 26 th Annual Banquet of Chein Kuo High
  School Alumni Association of Southern California; FENGSHANG Chamber of
  Commerce Homeco Celebration and 10th Anniversary events; City Employee
  Halloween Lunch; Garvey Education Foundation Annual Gala Awards; and North
  American Chinese University Alumni Alliance (NACUAA) Guandam Poker Game.

  Council Member Wu reported on his attendance at the Fall Fun Festival, the Chinese
  University Alumni Association Alliance of Southern California 23 rd SZM Outdoor Gala,
  Garvey Education Foundation event, San Gabriel Village Halloween Night; and a San

I  Gabriel Veterans' Memorial Coalition Fundraiser.

  Mayor Menchaca commented on the Dodgers winning the World Series and on the
  City's Dia de los Muertos events; reported on her attendance at a press conference
  about the Asian Youth Center's partnership with the California Conservation Corps,
  Garvey Education Foundation event, Tawa Gateway grand opening, and Journey of
  Faith art exhibit at the San Gabriel Mission Church Museum; and announced an
  upcoming free Community Emergency Response Team (CERT) program hosted by the
  San Gabriel Fire Department, and that applications for the Community Services
  Commission Youth Ambassador program are due by November 7, 2025.

  10. CLOSED SESSION - None.

  11. ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 7:35 P.M.

  Respectfully submitted:

I

I
